target: Validate a claim about episodic memory using a timestamped event store and recall query. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Validate episodic memory — human review
competency.outcome: Validate a claim about episodic memory using a timestamped event store and recall query. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.artifact: a timestamped event store and recall query

competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in a timestamped event store and recall query.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report event precision and temporal ordering with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: inventing missing events.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of episodic memory.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report event precision and temporal ordering against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for inventing missing events; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
